I personally don't know how to inspect those windows crash dumps but I doubt they will be of much help, if you are using an official build, due to missing debug symbols.

I'd recommend you take a look at https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/contributing/development/compiling/compiling_for_windows.html to get a build with debug symbols running. Then launch that build via a console and edit your project as usual. If you get the crash again, the console will contain a stack trace which we will need to track this issue down.

I'm currently only aware of one outstanding completion issue that crashes (or used to crash) the engine: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/57669 but with the information here it's impossible to say whether these crashes are the same. If you get a custom build running you can also try applying https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/85361 maybe it helps to solve the crashes in your case.

Thanks for the reply. I did as you suggested and compiled a build with symbols and a few other things enabled ( _scons platform=windows production=yes debug_symbols=yes separate_debug_symbols=yes_ ). It took some time, but I did experience a crash today.

Godot v4.4.1.stable unknown - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700G with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

[godot.windows.opt.tools.64.exe.28488.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20957537/godot.windows.opt.tools.64.exe.28488.zip)

Don't know if it was a coincidence or not, but I believe that every time the editor crashed, I had a VM (Vmware Workstation) running.

Seems to be NV driver failiure:

Hello, just a quick update.
After cleaning up and updating my Nvidia drivers, the crashes seems to have diminished quite a bit, but are not gone completely. This might be an issue on my side, but its weird that it only crashes the Godot editor, not anything else.

Well, I've started working on other parts of my game, creating a few dozens of nodes, makings scripts and the crashes became frequent again. Fun stuff. Crashes happen mostly when saving the project.

Unfortunately, I'm using Godot 4.5 Beta 3 without Symbols...
Godot v4.5.beta3 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7680) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700G with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 63.29 GiB memory

[Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe.31060.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21337963/Godot_v4.5-beta3_win64.exe.31060.zip)

I will try to compile Godot with symbols once more.
Did this happen again? Otherwise I'd assume that this happened somewhere downstream of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109297

In the last few months, the editor crashed unexpectedly maybe 2 or 3 times. I'm currently on v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e].
The amount of crashed was reduced for sure.

This sounds to me like one source of crashes was eliminated. So I think we should close this, given that we fixed a source of crashes with autocompletion and that there aren't any more actionable details in here at the moment. Would that be alright with you?
Sure, that, would be fine with me. Thank you!
